name: Hometech Remodeling LLC
website: none (hometechremodeling.com is a parked domain listed for sale)
what_they_do: General remodeling and renovation business handling kitchen, bathroom, basement, whole-home and addition projects. BBB-accredited with an A+ grade.
customers: Homeowners in North Brunswick and surrounding Middlesex County towns

size_signals.signal: BuildZoom score 91, top 37% of NJ contractors, but no customer reviews on that platform
The domain matching its name resolves to a GoDaddy for-sale parking page

listing.rating: A+ (BBB grade, not a star rating)

website_review.trust_signals: BBB A+ accreditation is the only published proof point and it is not on a site they control
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The domain that carries their name is a parked for-sale page
website_review.search_basics: no first-party page; a Maps search for the name returns unrelated HomeTech firms in other states
top_issues: No website - the matching .com is parked and for sale
No Google Business Profile found for the name or phone
No customer reviews visible anywhere despite A+ BBB accreditation

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 0: Maps name search returns HomeTech Renovations (PA), Hometech Construction (CA) and Hometech Repair (FL), none of which is this company, and the batch phone number returned nothing. Answerable 0: no page with services, hours or area. Bookable 0: phone only.

operations_signals.signal: Accredited business with no visible review collection - no review funnel exists even though BBB grades it A+
Name collisions with out-of-state HomeTech companies mean customers who search the name may land with the wrong firm (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Buy back or replace the domain and launch a proper remodeling site with kitchen/bath/basement galleries and a quote form
top_opportunities.evidence: hometechremodeling.com resolves to a GoDaddy for-sale parking page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Create and claim a Google Business Profile with the correct name so 'Hometech Remodeling North Brunswick' stops resolving to out-of-state companies
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps name search returns only HomeTech firms in PA, CA and FL

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated review requests after project completion, since the A+ accreditation is invisible without reviews
top_opportunities.evidence: No reviews found on BuildZoom or elsewhere despite the accreditation

scores.reasons: Gap 5: parked domain and no listings. Ability to pay 3: whole-home and addition remodels plus BBB accreditation imply steady revenue. Ease 3: the domain is for sale, so some purchase-and-rebuild work precedes content. Evidence 2: BBB and BuildZoom corroborate the business, but I could not open either page (403).
